properties.NAME: ST. CLAIR (Ill.)
properties.CHANGE: ST. CLAIR (Ill.) gained from KNOX and non-county area in Indiana Territory, lost to RANDOLPH (Ill.); included all of present Wisconsin and parts of present Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, and Minnesota.
properties.CITATION: (Ind. Terr., Exec. Journal, 98-100; Pence and Armstrong, 212, 520)
